by
  let C := 2 * (sup_norm f)
  have : ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C :=
    by
      intro τ
      cases τ with q r
      obtain ⟨q', r'⟩ := q.rat_eq
      have hq : q' ≠ 0 := by exact q'.ne_zero
      have hr : r' ≠ 0 := by exact r'.ne_zero
      have hq_r : q' * r' ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hq hr; contradiction
      let τ' := (q' / r') + (i : ℂ) * (r' / r')
      have hτ' : τ' ∈ UpperHalfPlane := by
        refine ⟨_, _, _⟩
        exact (q' / r').rat
        exact (r' / r').rat
        exact (0 < r' / r')
      have h_cont : Continuous (f ∘ (λ τ : UpperHalfPlane, τ')) := by
        apply Continuous.comp hf_cont
        apply Continuous.id
      have h_bounded_at_infty : UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty (f ∘ (λ τ : UpperHalfPlane, τ')) :=
        by
          intros ε
          rcases hf_infinity ε with ⟨δ, hδ⟩
          use δ
          intro τ
          have hτ : τ ∈ UpperHalfPlane := by assumption
          have h_im : Im τ ≥ δ := by assumption
          have h_im' : Im (τ') ≥ δ := by
            have h_im_τ' : Im τ' = Im (q' / r' + i * (r' / r')) := by rfl
            have h_im_τ' : Im τ' = (r' / r') := by rfl
            exact ge_of_le_of_gt (r' / r') δ
          have h_bounded : ‖f τ'‖ ≤ ε := by
            apply hf_infinity ε
            exact h_im'
          exact h_bounded
      have h_bounded : ‖f τ‖ ≤ ε := by
        apply h_bounded_at_infty ε
        exact h_im
      exact h_bounded
  exists C
